name: Omae no Supacha de Sekai o Sukue
original_name: お前のスパチャで世界を救え
source: On August 31st, VTuber Harukige Nia vanishes after her one-year anniversary stream. Devastated, our protagonist wakes up one day to find himself sent back in time, one week before Nia's disappearance! Can you change her fate by supporting her through your comments and super chats?!
translation: 8月31日，虚拟主播春树花Nia在出道一周年纪念直播后消失了。主角为此悲痛不已，某天醒来，却发现自己回到了过去，距离Nia消失还有一周！通过评论和付费留言为她应援，你能改变她的命运吗？！
